::: {.hero}
# Predicting ATP Tennis Matches
### A Bradley-Terry model with regularised MAP estimation
:::

::: {.lead}
Can we predict who wins a professional tennis match better than the rankings can?
This project builds a Bradley-Terry model on ATP match data, fitting player
strengths by maximum a posteriori estimation and tuning the priors by
cross-validated grid search.
:::



## Results

The tuned model reached roughly 64.5% out-of-sample accuracy on unseen matches.
More detail on the methodology, the estimation approach, and the evaluation is on
the [Model page](model.qmd).
